proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C hBC h hd
  have hpos : 0 < dist B C := dist_pos.mpr hBC
  have hAC : A ≠ C := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [dist_comm] at hd
    linarith
  have hAB : A ≠ B := by
    rintro rfl
    rw [dist_self] at hd
    linarith
  have s := EuclideanGeometry.sin_angle_mul_dist_of_angle_eq_pi_div_two (p₁ := B) (p₂ := C) (p₃ := A) h
  rw [dist_comm B A, hd] at s
  have hs : Real.sin (EuclideanGeometry.angle C A B) = Real.sin (Real.pi / 6) := by
    rw [Real.sin_pi_div_six]
    apply mul_right_cancel₀ hpos.ne'
    linarith
  have lt := EuclideanGeometry.angle_lt_pi_div_two_of_angle_eq_pi_div_two (p₁ := B) (p₂ := C) (p₃ := A) h hAC
  have nn := EuclideanGeometry.angle_nonneg C A B
  have hA : EuclideanGeometry.angle C A B = Real.pi / 6 :=
    Real.injOn_sin ⟨by linarith [Real.pi_pos], lt.le⟩ ⟨by linarith [Real.pi_pos], by linarith [Real.pi_pos]⟩ hs
  have sum := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_add_angle_eq_pi C hAB.symm
  exact ⟨hA, by linarith⟩
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C : P), B ≠ C → EuclideanGeometry.angle B C A = Real.pi / 2 → dist A B = 2 * dist B C → EuclideanGeometry.angle C A B = Real.pi / 6 ∧ EuclideanGeometry.angle A B C = Real.pi / 3
